RUINA MOBILE - QUICK INSTALL
============================

1. Copy EVERYTHING in this zip into your "Library Of Ruina" folder,
   next to LibraryOfRuina.exe. Afterwards that folder should contain:

     LibraryOfRuina.exe
     LibraryOfRuina_Data\
     BepInEx\                      <- new
     winhttp.dll                   <- new
     doorstop_config.ini           <- new
     .doorstop_version             <- new (may be hidden)

2. In Winlator (or GameHub / GameNative), add this environment variable
   to the container or game shortcut:

     WINEDLLOVERRIDES=winhttp=n,b

   Without it Wine uses its own winhttp.dll and the plugin never starts.

3. Start LibraryOfRuina.exe. The first start takes longer (BepInEx sets
   itself up). A small "SET" button appears in the top-left corner.

4. If you do not see SET, open BepInEx\LogOutput.log and look for
   "Ruina Mobile loaded". No log file at all = step 2 is missing.

Full guide: https://github.com/cng605568-art/LibaryOfRuina
